title: price_table.v1
description: The versioned model price table the cost ledger and the orchestrator compute spend from (03_InfrastructureZone/05_Cost.md §5; AGENTS.md → Agent Rules, one budget per ticket). Kept in version control; a price change is a new version, never an edit, and every computed cost names the version it used. Rates are integer micro-USD per million tokens, keyed by provider and model_id exactly as token_record.v1 carries them, so no floating point enters a cost. One call costs ceil((prompt_tokens × prompt + cached_tokens × cached + completion_tokens × completion) / 1,000,000) micro-USD, rounded up per call. A call whose provider and model_id have no row is unpriced: the consumer fails closed (no further model call for that ticket; it moves to Blocked), never prices it at zero. Each provider and model_id pair appears once.

version.description: Date of the change and a sequence number, e.g. 2026-11-08.1. Named by every computed cost and by builder.spec.v1's budget.

rate.description: Micro-USD per million tokens: $0.15 per million tokens is 150000.

model_id.description: Same pattern as token_record.v1's model_id; matched exactly.

basis.description: Where the rate comes from. A self-hosted model is priced from its measured compute cost per token, so its spend still counts against the budget.

rates.description: One rate per token_record.v1 count: prompt_tokens, cached_tokens, completion_tokens.

source.description: Where the rate was read or how it was measured, so a reviewer can check it.
